notes.title: Devlog - Fogreach: Shadow Whisperers Update - V1
notes.content:
We've been hard at work making some exciting changes to Fogreach: Shadow Whisperers! 
Here's what's new:

[olist]
 Flashlight Battery Packs: Now you'll find battery packs scattered throughout the first house, ensuring you never run out of light when exploring the dark corners of Fogreach.
 Jump Scares added: Brace yourself for some heart-pounding moments! We've added jump scares to keep you on your toes and heighten the suspense as you navigate through the eerie atmosphere of Fogreach.
 Dialogue tweaks: We've fine-tuned the dialogue to enhance the narrative experience, offering deeper character development and more immersive storytelling.
 Unlock Fogreach: Prepare to venture into the mysterious second zone of Fogreach! With new challenges and secrets awaiting, the journey to Fogreach continues to unfold.
 Save system in progress: We're currently working on implementing a robust save system, including the ability to save cinematic sequences. It's possible that the whole thing is still buggy. Our beta testers will check this out 😛
[/olist]
Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to refine and expand the world of Fogreach! Wishlist now on Steam to join the adventure: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825430/

🔗 We've been hard at work making some exciting changes to Fogreach!
